item.title: Walking by the Spirit and Not by the Flesh
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains what it means to walk by the Spirit and not by the flesh, drawing from Galatians 5 and Romans 8 to encourage Spirit-empowered Christian living.

item.title: Job 9: Longing for a Mediator Before a Holy God
item.description: In Job 9, Job stands in awe of God’s holiness, confronts the limits of human righteousness, and longs for a mediator—fulfilled in Jesus Christ alone.

item.title: Persevering Through Trials with Faith and Hope
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how believers persevere through trials by trusting God’s sovereignty, praying faithfully, and fixing their hope on Christ.

item.description: Job 10 shows how biblical lament expresses faith as Job brings his suffering honestly before God and finds hope that ultimately points to Christ.

item.title: Why the Local Church Matters for Christian Growth and Perseverance
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains why the local church is essential for Christian growth, perseverance, and faithfulness, and how God uses preaching, sacraments, shepherding, and community to sustain believers.
